translations.idiomatic: When Yixuan first received Zhi's report he that day raised troops and sent urgent word to Xiaowu; by provisional appointment Zhi was promoted General Who Pacifies the North.

sentences.zh: 孝武即位，加質車騎將軍、開府儀同三司、都督江州諸軍事。

translations.literal: When Xiaowu succeeded he added for Zhi General of Chariots and Cavalry, Grand Commander with credentials equal to the Three Dukes, and overseer of Jiang Province military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiaowu succeeded he added for Zhi general of chariots and cavalry, grand commander with credentials equal to the Three Dukes, and overseer of Jiang Province military affairs.

sentences.zh: 使質自白下步上，薛安都、程天祚等亦自南掖門入，與質同會太極殿庭，生禽元凶，仍使質留守朝堂，封始興郡公。

translations.literal: He ordered Zhi to ascend from Baixia on foot; Xue Andu, Cheng Tianzuo and the rest also entered from the Southern Flanking Gate; together with Zhi they met in the court of the Hall of Supreme Pole, captured the usurper alive, and still had Zhi garrison the court hall; he was enfeoffed Duke of Shixing Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Zhi to ascend from Baixia on foot; Xue Andu, Cheng Tianzuo and the rest also entered from the southern flanking gate; together with Zhi they met in the court of the Hall of Supreme Pole, captured the usurper alive, and still had Zhi garrison the court hall; he was enfeoffed duke of Shixing commandery.

sentences.zh: 之鎮，舫千餘乘，部伍前後百餘里，六平乘並施龍子幡。

translations.literal: Going to his post there were more than a thousand boats; his retinue stretched more than a hundred li front and back; six level carriages all bore dragon-son banners.
translations.idiomatic: Going to his post there were more than a thousand boats; his retinue stretched more than a hundred li front and back; six level carriages all bore dragon-son banners.

sentences.zh: 時孝武自攬威權，而質以少主遇之，刑政慶賞，不復諮稟朝廷，自謂人才足為一世英傑。

translations.literal: At that time Xiaowu himself grasped authority, yet Zhi treated him as a young lord; punishments, governance, rewards and gifts no longer consulted the court; he considered his talent enough to be the age's hero.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Xiaowu himself grasped authority, yet Zhi treated him as a young lord; punishments, governance, rewards and gifts no longer consulted the court; he considered his talent enough to be the age's hero.

sentences.zh: 始聞國禍，便有異圖，以義宣凡闇易制，欲外相推奉以成其志。

translations.literal: From the first hearing of the national calamity he already had a divergent plot; because Yixuan was ordinary and dim and easy to control, he wished outwardly to push and uphold him to fulfill his intent.
translations.idiomatic: From the first hearing of the national calamity he already had a divergent plot; because Yixuan was ordinary and dim and easy to control, he wished outwardly to push and uphold him to fulfill his intent.

sentences.zh: 及至江陵，便致拜稱名。

translations.literal: On reaching Jiangling he at once performed bowing and used the personal name.
translations.idiomatic: On reaching Jiangling he at once performed bowing and used the personal name.

sentences.zh: 質于義宣雖為兄弟，而年近大十歲。

translations.literal: Though Zhi and Yixuan were like brothers, Zhi was nearly ten years older.
translations.idiomatic: Though Zhi and Yixuan were like brothers, Zhi was nearly ten years older.

sentences.zh: 義宣驚曰：「君何意拜弟？

translations.literal: Yixuan startled said, "Sir, what intent in bowing to your younger brother?
translations.idiomatic: Yixuan startled said, "Sir, what intent in bowing to your younger brother?

sentences.zh: 「質曰：「事中宜然。

translations.literal: Zhi said, "In affairs it is fitting so.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi said, "In affairs it is fitting so.

sentences.zh: 」時義宣已推崇孝武，故其計不行。

translations.literal: At that time Yixuan had already upheld Xiaowu, therefore his plan could not proceed.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Yixuan had already upheld Xiaowu, therefore his plan could not proceed.

sentences.zh: 每慮事泄，及至新亭，又拜江夏王義恭。

translations.literal: Always fearing the affair would leak, on reaching Xinting he again bowed to Prince Jiangxia Yigong.
translations.idiomatic: Always fearing the affair would leak, on reaching Xinting he again bowed to Prince Jiangxia Yigong.

sentences.zh: 義恭愕然，問質所以。

translations.literal: Yigong was stunned and asked Zhi's reason.
translations.idiomatic: Yigong was stunned and asked Zhi's reason.

sentences.zh: 質曰：「天下屯危，禮異常日，前在荊州，亦拜司空。」

translations.literal: Zhi said, "The realm is in peril and ritual differs from ordinary days; earlier in Jing Province I also bowed to the Minister of Works."
translations.idiomatic: Zhi said, "The realm is in peril and ritual differs from ordinary days; earlier in Jing Province I also bowed to the minister of works."

sentences.zh: 爽失旨，即起兵，遣人至都報弟瑜，席捲奔叛。

translations.literal: Shuang lost favor and at once raised troops; he sent men to the capital to report to his younger brother Yu; they swept up in flight and rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Shuang lost favor and at once raised troops; he sent men to the capital to report to his younger brother Yu; they swept up in flight and rebellion.

sentences.zh: 瑜弟弘為質府佐，孝武馳使報質誅弘，於是執台使，狼狽舉兵，馳報義宣。

translations.literal: Yu's younger brother Hong was on Zhi's staff; Xiaowu sent urgent word to Zhi to execute Hong; thereupon he seized the imperial messenger, raised troops in disorder, and raced to report Yixuan.
translations.idiomatic: Yu's younger brother Hong was on Zhi's staff; Xiaowu sent urgent word to Zhi to execute Hong; thereupon he seized the imperial messenger, raised troops in disorder, and raced to report Yixuan.

sentences.zh: 孝武遣撫軍將軍柳元景統豫州刺史王玄謨等屯梁山洲，兩岸築偃月壘，水陸待之。

translations.literal: Xiaowu sent Pacifying Army General Liu Yuanjing commanding Xu Inspector Wang Xuanmo and the rest to garrison Liangshan Isle; on both banks they built crescent ramparts and waited by land and water.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaowu sent pacifying army general Liu Yuanjing commanding Xu inspector Wang Xuanmo and the rest to garrison Liangshan Isle; on both banks they built crescent ramparts and waited by land and water.

sentences.zh: 元景檄書宣告，而義宣亦相次系至。

translations.literal: Yuanjing's proclamation was issued; Yixuan's letters also arrived one after another.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjing's proclamation was issued; Yixuan's letters also arrived one after another.

sentences.zh: 江夏王義恭書曰：「昔桓玄借兵于仲堪，有似今日。

translations.literal: Prince Jiangxia Yigong wrote, "Formerly Huan Xuan borrowed troops from Yin Zhongkan — much like today.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Jiangxia Yigong wrote, "Formerly Huan Xuan borrowed troops from Yin Zhongkan — much like today.

sentences.zh: 」義宣由此與質相疑。

translations.literal: Yixuan therefore grew suspicious of Zhi.
translations.idiomatic: Yixuan therefore grew suspicious of Zhi.

sentences.zh: 質進計曰：「今以萬人取南州，則梁山中絕，萬人綴玄謨，必不敢輕動。

translations.literal: Zhi advanced a plan, "Now with ten thousand men take Southern Province and the Liangshan route is cut; ten thousand men pin Xuanmo and he will surely not dare move lightly.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi advanced a plan, "Now with ten thousand men take Southern Province and the Liangshan route is cut; ten thousand men pin Xuanmo and he will surely not dare move lightly.

sentences.zh: 質浮舟外江，直向石頭，此上略也。」

translations.literal: Zhi floats boats on the outer river and goes straight to Stone City — this is the upper strategy."
translations.idiomatic: Zhi floats boats on the outer river and goes straight to Stone City — this is the upper strategy."

sentences.zh: 義宣將從之，義宣客顏樂之說義宣曰：「質若復拔東城，則大功盡歸之矣。

translations.literal: Yixuan was about to follow it; his guest Yan Yuezhi persuaded Yixuan, "If Zhi again takes the eastern wall the great merit will all belong to him.
translations.idiomatic: Yixuan was about to follow it; his guest Yan Yuezhi persuaded Yixuan, "If Zhi again takes the eastern wall the great merit will all belong to him.

sentences.zh: 宜遣麾下自行。

translations.literal: You should send your own trusted men to go themselves.
translations.idiomatic: You should send your own trusted men to go themselves.

sentences.zh: 」義宣遣腹心劉諶之就質陳軍城南。

translations.literal: Yixuan sent his intimate Liu Chenzhi to Zhi's camp south of the city.
translations.idiomatic: Yixuan sent his intimate Liu Chenzhi to Zhi's camp south of the city.

sentences.zh: 玄謨留羸弱守城，悉精兵出戰。

translations.literal: Xuanmo left the weak to guard the city and sent all elite troops out to battle.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanmo left the weak to guard the city and sent all elite troops out to battle.

sentences.zh: 薛安都騎軍前出，垣護之督諸將繼之，乃大潰。

translations.literal: Xue Andu's cavalry advanced first; Yuan Huzhi commanded the generals to follow; they were greatly routed.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Andu's cavalry advanced first; Yuan Huzhi commanded the generals to follow; they were greatly routed.

sentences.zh: 質求義宣欲計事，密已走矣。

translations.literal: Zhi sought Yixuan wanting to consult on affairs; Yixuan had secretly already fled.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi sought Yixuan wanting to consult on affairs; Yixuan had secretly already fled.

sentences.zh: 質不知所為，亦走至尋陽，焚府舍，載妓妾入南湖，摘蓮噉之。

translations.literal: Zhi knew not what to do and also fled to Xunyang; he burned the official residence, loaded concubines and entertainers into South Lake, and ate lotus pods.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi knew not what to do and also fled to Xunyang; he burned the official residence, loaded concubines and entertainers into South Lake, and ate lotus pods.

sentences.zh: 追兵至，以荷覆頭，沈于水，出鼻。

translations.literal: Pursuers arrived; he covered his head with lotus leaves, sank in the water, and left his nose out.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuers arrived; he covered his head with lotus leaves, sank in the water, and left his nose out.

sentences.zh: 軍主鄭俱兒望見，射之中心，兵刃亂至，腹胃纏縈水草。

translations.literal: Commander Zheng Ju'er saw him, shot him in the center; blades fell in confusion; belly and stomach were tangled with water weeds.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Zheng Ju'er saw him, shot him in the center; blades fell in confusion; belly and stomach were tangled with water weeds.

sentences.zh: 隊主裘應斬質，傳首建鄴。

translations.literal: Squad leader Qiu Ying beheaded Zhi and sent the head to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Squad leader Qiu Ying beheaded Zhi and sent the head to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 錄尚書江夏王義恭等奏依漢王莽事，漆其頭藏於武庫，詔可。

translations.literal: Recorder of Affairs Prince Jiangxia Yigong and the rest memorialized following the Han precedent on Wang Mang — lacquer the head and store it in the armory; the edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: Recorder of affairs Prince Jiangxia Yigong and the rest memorialized following the Han precedent on Wang Mang — lacquer the head and store it in the armory; the edict approved.

sentences.zh: 論曰：趙倫之、蕭思話俱以外戚之親，並接風雲之會，言親則在趙為密，論望則于蕭為重。

translations.literal: The appraisal says: Zhao Lunzhi and Xiao Sihua were both imperial in-laws who met the turning of wind and cloud; speaking of kinship Zhao was closer, speaking of standing Xiao was weightier.
translations.idiomatic: The appraisal says: Zhao Lunzhi and Xiao Sihua were both imperial in-laws who met the turning of wind and cloud; speaking of kinship Zhao was closer, speaking of standing Xiao was weightier.

sentences.zh: 古人云：「人能弘道」，蓋此之謂乎。

translations.literal: The ancients said, "It is man who enlarges the Way" — perhaps this is meant.
translations.idiomatic: The ancients said, "It is man who enlarges the Way" — perhaps this is meant.

sentences.zh: 惠開親禮雖篤，弟隙尤著，方寸之內，孝友異情。

translations.literal: Though Huikai's affection and ritual toward kin were deep, estrangement from his brothers was especially marked — within a single inch filial piety and brotherhood held different feelings.
translations.idiomatic: Though Huikai's affection and ritual toward kin were deep, estrangement from his brothers was especially marked — within a single inch filial piety and brotherhood held different feelings.

sentences.zh: 嶮于山川，有驗於此。

translations.literal: More rugged than mountains and rivers — here is proof.
translations.idiomatic: More rugged than mountains and rivers — here is proof.

sentences.zh: 臧氏文義之美，傳於累代，含文以致誅滅，好亂之所致乎。

translations.literal: The Zang clan's literary righteousness was famed through successive generations; embracing letters yet meeting execution and extinction — was it caused by loving disorder?
translations.idiomatic: The Zang clan's literary righteousness was famed through successive generations; embracing letters yet meeting execution and extinction — was it caused by loving disorder?
